header.title: Help & Guide
header.subtitle: Everything you need to know about Trakalog

whatIsTrakalog.title: What is Trakalog?
whatIsTrakalog.body: Trakalog is the intelligent nervous system for your music catalog. Upload your tracks, and Trakalog protects them with invisible audio watermarking, analyzes them with Sonic DNA, connects them to opportunities via Smart A&R, and tracks every interaction on your shared links.

settingUpWorkspace.title: Setting up your workspace
settingUpWorkspace.body: Your workspace is your creative space — an artist project, a label, a studio. Customize it with your branding (hero image, logo, colors) in Settings → Branding.

uploadingFirstTrack.title: Uploading your first track
uploadingFirstTrack.body: Go to Tracks and click Upload Track. Use Quick Upload for instant bulk import, or go step-by-step to add full details (lyrics, stems, splits, metadata).

whatIsSonicDna.title: What is Sonic DNA?
whatIsSonicDna.body: When you upload a track, Trakalog analyzes the audio and creates a unique fingerprint: BPM, key, energy curves, spectral characteristics (brightness, warmth), and structure. This powers the Smart A&R matching.

maximizeSonicDna.title: How to maximize Sonic DNA
maximizeSonicDna.body: The more metadata you add (genre, mood tags, lyrics, language, type, gender), the better the AI understands your music and finds opportunities.

usingSmartAr.title: Using Smart A&R
usingSmartAr.body: Click the Smart A&R icon in the header. Paste any brief or describe what you're looking for. Trakalog scans your entire catalog using Sonic DNA data to find the best matches.

uploadingTracks.title: Uploading tracks
uploadingTracks.body: Single or bulk upload. Quick Upload skips all details. Sonic DNA auto-detects BPM and key after upload.

editingTrackDetails.title: Editing track details
editingTrackDetails.body: Click any track to edit 17+ metadata fields: title, artist, genre, mood tags, BPM, key, language, type, ISRC, UPC, and more.

managingStems.title: Managing stems
managingStems.body: Upload stems (vocals, drums, bass, etc.) in the Stems tab of each track. Organize by type.

trackSections.title: Track sections
trackSections.body: Double-click on the waveform to add section markers (Intro, Verse, Chorus, Drop). Rename by double-clicking the label.

lyrics.title: Lyrics
lyrics.body: Add lyrics manually, import from PDF/TXT, or auto-transcribe with AI. Lyrics are synced to Sonic DNA for text-based matching.

creatingPlaylists.title: Creating playlists
creatingPlaylists.body: Create themed playlists with custom gradient colors and mood/genre tags.

sharingPlaylists.title: Sharing playlists
sharingPlaylists.body: Share entire playlists with one branded link. Recipients see your branding.

creatingPitch.title: Creating a pitch
creatingPitch.body: Select tracks or a playlist, add contacts, write a message. Trakalog sends a branded email with a secure listening link.

trackingEngagement.title: Tracking engagement
trackingEngagement.body: See who opened your pitch, how long they listened, which sections they replayed. Pipeline view: Draft → Sent → Opened → Responded.

sharedLinks.title: Shared links
sharedLinks.body: Create secure links for tracks, playlists, stems, or full Trakalog Packs (ZIP with track, cover, lyrics PDF, splits PDF).

gateScreen.title: Gate screen
gateScreen.body: Every shared link has a gate screen that collects the visitor's name, email, role, and company before they can listen.

passwordProtection.title: Password protection
passwordProtection.body: Optionally protect links with a password. Set expiration dates.

audioWatermarking.title: Audio watermarking
audioWatermarking.body: Every listener receives an invisibly watermarked version of your audio. Each watermark is unique per visitor.

leakTracing.title: Leak tracing
leakTracing.body: If your music leaks, go to Settings → Security → Leak Tracing. Upload the leaked file and Trakalog identifies exactly who received that version.

howCollected.title: How contacts are collected
howCollected.body: Contacts are added automatically when someone listens to your shared links (gate screen), when collaborators scan your studio QR code, or when you add them manually.

exportingContacts.title: Exporting contacts
exportingContacts.body: Export your contact list to PDF, CSV, or Excel anytime.

addingSplits.title: Adding splits
addingSplits.body: In each track's details, add collaborators with their role (Songwriter, Producer, Artist, Musician), PRO, and IPI number. Auto-complete suggests contacts from your workspace.

digitalSignatures.title: Digital signatures
digitalSignatures.body: Send splits for signature. Each collaborator signs on a dedicated page with a canvas signature. Download the signed PDF.

studioQrCode.title: Studio QR code
studioQrCode.body: Generate a QR code for your studio session. Collaborators scan it to fill in their info and contributions remotely.

multiWorkspace.title: Multi-workspace
multiWorkspace.body: Create separate workspaces for different projects: your artist name, a label, a client. Switch between them with the workspace switcher.

teamPermissions.title: Team permissions
teamPermissions.body: Invite team members with 4 permission levels: Viewer (listen only), Pitcher (create playlists & pitch), Editor (modify metadata & stems), Admin (full control). Each member gets a professional title displayed on credits.

catalogSharing.title: Catalog sharing
catalogSharing.body: Share your entire catalog with another workspace (label, manager). They can pitch your tracks under their branding while you keep full control. Revoke access anytime.

tipsBestPractices.title: Tips & Best Practices
tips: The more metadata you add, the better Smart A&R matches your tracks to briefs.
Add mood tags — they help A&R professionals find exactly what they're looking for.
Add lyrics to unlock text-based search and matching.
Set up your branding before sharing links — first impressions matter.
Use Quick Upload for bulk imports, then add details later at your own pace.
Create sections on your waveform for professional track presentations.
Check your Shared Links dashboard regularly — see who's listening.
Use the Studio QR code during recording sessions to capture splits in real-time.
